summary.name: International Audio Laboratories Erlangen
summary.one_liner: AudioLabs is a research institution jointly run by Fraunhofer IIS and FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg that works on audio coding, audio signal analysis and perceptual spatial audio processing.
keywords: neural network pitch loudness latent space
use_cases: Reading research on audio coding and signal analysis
Learning PyTorch through signal processing examples
Finding papers on neural audio synthesis and speech
Following academic work on perceptual audio quality metrics
Self-study of machine learning for audio
summary.what_it_does: The page is the homepage of the AudioLabs research institution, founded in 2010 and jointly operated by Fraunhofer IIS and FAU. It lists research areas including audio coding, audio signal analysis and perceptual spatial audio signal processing. It features a highlighted study by Simon Schwär on how the similarity measure used in training shapes what a small neural network learns about pitch and loudness. It also announces an open-access PyTorch textbook, PCPT, by Meinard Müller and Sebastian Strahl, with freely available Jupyter notebooks. A list of recent publications and conference papers (ICASSP 2026, EUSIPCO 2026, Interspeech 2026) is included.
notable: Joint institution of Fraunhofer IIS and FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg, founded 2010
Open-access PCPT PyTorch book with freely available GitHub and HTML notebooks
Publishes research on neural audio, speech synthesis and audio quality metrics
caveats: Page is a lab homepage and research index, not a downloadable tool; no software product described
Embedded videos transfer usage data to YouTube
